thread:
Priya (Design): quick thread about the batch vectors inspector + export microflow. goal: settle column order, compact inspector behavior, keyboard shortcuts, and a11y labels. mock: https://www.figma.com/file/example-compact
Sam (Product): customers want embedding columns after metadata, not interleaved with ids/scores. prefer: vector_id,score,embedding_0...embedding_N,source_text(optional).
Tori (Eng): agree on column order. implementation note: exporting floats vs base64 affects CSV size. propose CSV with truncated precision (6 decimals) by default to save bytes, with a toggle "Full precision" in advanced options.
Uma (A11y): accessibility notes: 1) expand/collapse needs aria-expanded + aria-controls. 2) add a keyboard shortcut: press "E" when row focused to expand. 3) copy-id button should have aria-label: "Copy vector id {id}".
Vik (QA): add tests for locale number formats (comma vs dot) and Excel import. test precision toggle for parsing. Also test keyboard shortcut conflicts.
Wen (Support): request: include small checksum/hash column (sha1) in exports to help customers verify integrity when re-uploading. Also add collapsed "Show example headers" to reduce tickets.
Priya (Design): updated copy proposal for export modal: title "Export vectors"; helper "Includes vector ids and scores. Toggle to include original source text (opt-in)."; primary "Download CSV"; advanced link "Export options" (precision, format). show example headers collapsed.
Sam (Product): also add limit blurb: "Up to 10k vectors; larger exports run in background and you'll get a link." plus retention note for generated files.
Tori (Eng): estimates: compact inspector + keyboard shortcut ~2 dev days. export precision toggle + background export job + checksum ~5 dev days.
Uma (A11y): I'll post concise a11y acceptance criteria in this thread by EOD covering focus management, live region announcements for export start/completion, and accessible notifications for background jobs.
Priya (Design): action items: Tori to spec formats & estimates; Uma to add a11y criteria; Vik to draft QA checklist; Wen to write support blurb. I'll update Figma and drop the example headers. Thanks! :sparkles:
